issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Feeding our Future Defendant Sentenced to 17 Years in Prison For His Role in $250 Million Fraud Scheme
supports: Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff was sentenced to 210 months in prison and three years of supervised release.
Shariff was ordered to pay $47,920,514 in restitution.
does_not_support: The restitution order is not proof that $47,920,514 has been collected.
The release does not establish that identical Empire-family restitution orders are independent and additive.
